title: GTA6 Limited Edition Controller Revealed at September 2026 State of Play
description: Sony's back-to-back State of Play showcases for September 2026 brought major reveals, including a surprise GTA 6 limited edition controller.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Sony Delivers Back-to-Back State of Play Showcases

In a first-of-its-kind broadcasting strategy, Sony recently hosted two State of Play livestreams back-to-back, giving the gaming community an unprecedented double-feature of announcements. The event kicked off with a standard showcase packed with general updates, immediately followed by a dedicated State of Play Japan livestream focusing on titles from Japanese and Asian developers. Together, these two presentations delivered a massive wave of reveals and trailers.

## Major Highlights from the Showcase

The main State of Play livestream was filled with significant updates for prominent titles. Viewers were treated to major new content updates for Gran Turismo 7 and Saros, a fresh look at Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, alongside various smaller announcements. 

Among the unexpected smaller reveals, one specific item caught the attention of the wider gaming community: a GTA 6 limited edition controller. While full details and specifications for this hardware addition were brief during the broadcast, its mere appearance has sent speculation into overdrive regarding future marketing and hardware partnerships surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming title.

## Community Reaction and Analysis

Following the dual broadcasts, gaming outlets like Push Square launched community polls to gauge player reactions to the packed double-feature. This innovative streaming format allowed Sony to segment its audience and deliver targeted content efficiently.

Industry observers note that while major gameplay breakdowns for certain tentpole titles like GTA 6 are heavily guarded by their respective publishers, peripheral and hardware teases like the newly revealed controller serve to keep the hype train moving forward. Fans are now eagerly voting and discussing how this historic double-showcase ranks compared to previous Sony presentations.

## Editor's Take

Sony's back-to-back State of Play experiment was a bold and exciting move for the September 2026 lineup. While the reveal of a GTA 6 limited edition controller is a tasty appetizer, players are undoubtedly still hungry for more direct game footage. It's a clever way to keep anticipation simmering.
